lockedDesign: Render each absolute fixed preload path with forward slash separators and surround with literal double quotes: --require "C:/path with spaces/preload.cjs". Reject embedded quote, NUL, CR or LF and nonabsolute path. No shell invocation or user-supplied options. Preserve Unicode paths.

Producer uses P.node_preload_options(guard). Fence demands exact equality against same renderer(argv[7]); only then replaces options with renderer(argv[7], binding[preload][path]). No contains/equivalence shortcut, preexisting environment bypass or permissive parser.

Order remains journey preload first, browser-fence preload second for helper; Web has journey only. Browser binding continues recording actual filesystem path/hash; option spelling normalization does not alter pin path or digest.
Native Node fixture is required to validate actual Windows parsing; source inference alone does not prove the fix.

Move no_reparse and check_disposable responsibility to existing source_release.py path-admission owner; lifecycle reexports imported functions to preserve P.no_reparse and L.check_disposable callers. source_release imports execution only; execution imports protocol, neither imports lifecycle, so no new cycle. No new file/framework or source-family cardinality.

Require namespace, stage, owner.json and their traversed ancestors be existing regular/non-reparse paths; stage lexical and resolved identity must equal namespace/source. Owner must be a real regular file rather than a symlink to one. Fail filesystem errors closed.

If dependency supplied, require exact lexical path stage/EXTENSIONS/CVF_v1.6_AGENT_PLATFORM/cvf-web/node_modules, within stage, with non-reparse ancestors below stage; require existing directory with Windows mount-point/junction reparse tag, not an ordinary directory or symlink. Require exact resolved target equality to admitted modules, existing directory target, and target outside stage/namespace. Missing/dangling/malformed/repointed entry refuses.

Validate admitted dependency before walk; use os.walk(topdown=True, followlinks=False, onerror=raise). At its parent, revalidate identity then remove exactly that name from dirs before recursion; never enumerate contents or target descendants. All remaining dirs/files get no_reparse checks. No dependency means every reparse refuses.

Refuse unexpected symlink/junction/reparse, intermediary ancestor reparse, wrong target, missing target, escaped link path, wrong stage/namespace, owner reparse, inaccessible walk and unrecognized reparse tag. No broad name-based node_modules exception.

This is eligibility evidence only. No removal function, link unlink, shared-target mutation or retained-stage deletion. Snapshot identity validation is not an OS lock against concurrent hostile replacement; no race-free deletion claim.
